odc_type: NullPointerException due to unsafe toString() invocation
observation_summary: A NullPointerException is thrown when joining an array containing an object whose toString() method returns null.
reasoning_summary: The code in StringUtils.join attempts to calculate the initial capacity of a StringBuilder by calling .toString().length() on the first element of the array (or other elements). If an object in the array returns null from its toString() method, the subsequent call to .length() on that null result triggers a NullPointerException. The implementation assumes that toString() will always return a non-null String, which is not guaranteed by the Java contract.
